source.sdkAndRust: Reused unchanged build output from main checkout; no SDK or Rust source change in this candidate.

scope: All public intended-behaviour cases on the frozen combined candidate. Each case starts a fresh local stack. This does not replace private Console composition or hosted measurements.

environmentFailures.reason: Initial recovery runs used a Google test identity near expiry. Both passed with a fresh identity.
Initial terminal-failure scenarios could not start the local custody stack with the main checkout debug output. Both passed with the matching R155D local build.

buildNote.initialFailure: Main checkout debug Worker outputs did not reach the Router keyset readiness endpoint. Release cases passed.
buildNote.replacement: Copied debug Worker outputs used by the earlier successful R155D terminal contracts. Public TypeScript and SDK candidate unchanged.
